quarterly_data.signal: Alphabet had $242.8 billion of remaining performance obligations (revenue backlog) as of December 31, 2025, primarily related to Google Cloud, and expects to recognize just over 50% of it as revenue over the next 24 months.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue backlog $242.8 billion (December 31, 2025), primarily Google Cloud; just over 50% over the next 24 months

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditures, primarily investments in technical infrastructure, were $91.4 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025 versus $52.5 billion in 2024; for 2026 Alphabet expects to significantly increase its investment in technical infrastructure, including servers, network equipment and data centers, relative to 2025.

As of December 31, 2025, Alphabet's short-term material purchase commitments and other contractual obligations were $113.0 billion, mostly related to technical infrastructure and inventory orders. Alphabet uses contract manufacturers (not named) for its technical infrastructure (servers and networking equipment) and device assembly and may supply them with components purchased directly from suppliers.
quarterly_data.figure: short-term purchase commitments $113.0 billion (December 31, 2025), mostly technical infrastructure and inventory orders
